_doc: MCP tools by role. Names are the server's own (no mcp__slop-haus__ prefix); clients add `prefix`. Checked by server/internal/mcpserver (against what the server registers), server/internal/workspace, supervisor/tests/contracts and the pi extension test.

role_notes.console: What a Remote Control (pi) session is allowed: the whole server less the supervisor's claim tool and the steward-only assessment and draft tools.
role_notes.denied_to_headless: Claiming and waiting belong to the supervisor.
role_notes.denied_builtin_tools: A background watcher either exits or lingers looking alive while holding the integration lock.
